description: This Java class 'ControllerViewArtifactInfo' models information about a specific controller view in the OFBiz web framework, encapsulating details like its URL, URI, associated screen widget, and related request information. It provides methods to retrieve metadata, resolve related components, and support identification and comparison operations.

classes.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
classes.description: Models details about a controller view in OFBiz, including its URL, URI, associated screen, and request relationships, with methods for metadata retrieval and comparison.

methods.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the artifact info with controller XML URL, view URI, and artifact factory, also resolves associated screen widget if applicable.

methods.name: getControllerXmlUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the controller XML file.

methods.name: getViewUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the view.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a display name combining view URI and relative location.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for controller view info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Constructs a unique identifier combining controller URL and view URI.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL location of the controller XML file.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on controller URL and view URI.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on its string representation.

methods.name: getRequestsThatThisViewIsResponseTo
methods.description: Retrieves request information associated with this view.

methods.name: getScreenCalledByThisView
methods.description: Returns the screen widget invoked by this view, if applicable.
